newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong stocks expected to ease on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks expected to ease on profit-taking.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks are expected to ease on Thursday on profit-taking on banks and individual property stocks after a softer close on Wall Street overnight and a sell-off in the U.S. bond market, brokers said.
"The (Hang Seng) index may test a low of 14,150 today but it should see some support there as bargain hunters are earger to buy at lows," said Ricky Tam, research analyst at Delta Asia Securities.
The Hang Seng Index eased 0.68 of a point to 14,235.52 on Wednesday. Later, the Hang Seng London Reference Index rose 12.43 points to 14,247.95.
Peter Lai, associate director at OCBC Securities, said the market was likely to fluctuate within a range, with the focus on good quality red chips.
"Individual red chips should see good support even though the market is heading for a consolidation after the recent sharp gains," he added.
